notes.title: Glitch World is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Now available[/h1]

[b]Glitch World[/b] is now available on Steam. Will you be one of the first to try it out? 
We are looking forward to your feedback in the comments, reviews, and Steam discussion forum. 

All the best from your friends at Radar! <3 

[h3]If you can play it, play it![/h3]

notes.title: The Story Behind Glitch World: Skel and Oree
notes.content:
Skel and Oree are video game characters in a sitcom set in the real life. Somehow, Oree messed up and now you can play Glitch World.

[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@thisisradar]Learn more in the story on TikTok.[/url]

notes.title: Coming December 4th!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that Glitch World is releasing on [b]December 4th[/b] at the following times:

[list]
[*] 12:00 PM PST
[*] 8:00 PM GMT
[*] 9:00 PM CET
[/list]

Make sure you wishlist Glitch World now to be notified of the release and get a chance to profit from the release discount. 

Let us know in the comments if you have any questions.

We are excited! 
-Radar
